description: Change a map's title, context, travel mode, interests, day noun or whether it routes between stops.

context.description: Resulting stored context has a 10,240 UTF-8 byte limit. Retrying append repeats the text; replace is safe to retry.

day_noun.description: The word the map numbers its days with, when they are not days: "House" for houses to tour gives House 1, House 2. Default "Day"; "" resets it.

draft_handle.description: The draft_handle map_create returned; unsaved maps only.

expected_version.description: The version you planned this edit from. If someone else has since changed what it touches, nothing is applied and the result is a conflict with their changes and the current version.

route_stops.description: Whether plan lists draw routes and travel times between their places. Default true; false is for lists that are not journeys, such as one list per area.

name: map_update
title: Update map settings
